age: All females used in experiments were 8–12 weeks of age.
cell_type: CD4+ T cells from OT-II mouse donors were purified by magnetic-bead-based negative selection using a CD4+ T cell isolation kit (Miltenyi Biotec) per the manufacturer’s instructions.
developmental_stage: Mice were analysed on a rolling basis as they became pregnant.
material_type: Human plasma was collected from healthy women after provision of informed consent (IRB numbers 20–32077 and 19–29812, UCSF).
sample_source: OVA-specific B cells from maternal spleens were identified using the above OVA-tetramer and control-tetramer and a magnetic-bead-based enrichment protocol, as previously described.
sex: All females used in experiments were 8–12 weeks of age.
species: Here we provide evidence that glycan-mediated B cell suppression has a key role in establishing fetomaternal tolerance in mice.
strain: WT C57BL/6J and congenic CD45.1+ C57BL/6J (Ptprca) mice were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory.
tissue: Uterine tissues were fixed overnight at 4 °C in 4% paraformaldehyde/PBS and embedded in paraffin.
